attempt_counting_rule: Every distinct feature specification evaluated against the frozen 2017-2019 validation range consumes one attempt, including failed or discarded candidates. The matched control is budget-neutral only as a denominator.
success_criterion: On the frozen 2017-2019 validation range, the paired-bootstrap 95% CI for model RMSE minus closing-market RMSE must include zero.

free_sources_checked: ESPN scoreboard used for results only

block_reason: A lane without a historical closing benchmark cannot be validated against price.
